text: You paid for your plane ticket.
Some airlines sell more tickets than the plane has seats.
They're betting that a few passengers won't show up.
First, airlines must ask for volunteers to take a later flight.
If too few agree, some passengers can be denied boarding.
And here's what you should know:
On qualifying flights departing the U.S., you may be owed cash compensation.
So... how much would it take for you to give up your seat?
